title: Under the chairs
notes: Summit Express, base to tower 2, after the nine corridor firs were removed. Takes 1 and 2 (70 mm): the dolly ends 18 m up the line with the camera tilted up, so a descending chair is large in the upper half with the tower below it and the peak behind. Start the path when a descending chair passes x 3414 to 3420 (it is then about 12 m ahead of the end pose when the move stops; chairs run about 5 m/s, 28 m apart). Wind forced to (0.5, 0.5) with the wind op, map strength 0.70 at (3540, -2523) after 12 s; put (0.275, 0.275) back afterward. Take 3 is the 135 mm variant in alt135. Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60).

trigger.entity: a descending SkiLiftChairDQ4 (find with a two-sample dump near x 3440 to 3530)

alt135.notes: Between the two rope lines, a 1 m truck, the descending chairs come toward the camera against the snow slope and the sky. Start when a descending chair passes x 3438 to 3444.
